description: Two messages do the same job: the entry card says 'This code is wrong, expired, or already used. Run `agent-drive login`...' (command styled as code) while the approval banner says 'This request expired or was already used. Run `agent-drive login`...' with the backticks shown literally.
expected: One wording, command styled as code in both.
actual: Literal backtick characters in the banner.
suggested_fix: Render the command in a code element in the banner.

description: After a request expires, the open page keeps the full form (verification code kept, Approve enabled). The page shows no expiry time or countdown; the user learns of expiry only after typing the code and clicking Approve.
expected: Show 'Expires at HH:MM' or switch to an expired state.
suggested_fix: Use the request expiry to show a countdown and disable the form.

description: The entry-card message lumps three causes (wrong, expired, already used). After a successful approval, reopening the link implies failure, so a user who double-clicked or reloaded cannot tell the approval worked.
expected: 'This request was already approved' for a used code.
suggested_fix: Return a distinct state for approved requests.
